notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce {3}{B}{G}.
description:
Activate High Market by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, gaining you 1 life.
Activate Atzal's second ability by paying {3}{B}{G} and tapping it, returning Palinchron to the battlefield.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping Atzal, High Market, and five other lands that can produce {3}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity
